verses.pali: ธัมมะสัญญา โลเก ปิยะรูปัง สาตะรูปัง, เอตเถสา ตัณหา ปะหิยยะมานา ปะหิยยะติ, เอตถะ นิรุชฌะมานา นิรุชฌะติ.
verses.pali_roman: Dhammasaññā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahiyyamānā pahiyyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
verses.english: Perception of mind-objects in the world is dear and agreeable; there this craving is abandoned when it is abandoned, and there it ceases when it ceases.

vocabulary.meaning: volition, intention directed at a thing. The fourth aggregate, and what the Buddha identified kamma with — which is why the survey lists it between perception and craving
craving. As in the first run, it stands on both sides of the sentence here: craving for forms is itself named as a place where craving is abandoned
